title.zh: 在三宝颜锡布格省增设一个国会选区，为此修订第8973号共和国法（即三宝颜锡布格省宪章）
title.en: An Act Creating Another Congressional District in the Province of Zamboanga Sibugay, amending for the purpose Republic Act Numbered Eighty-Nine Hundred and Seventy-Three, otherwise known as the Charter of the Province of Zamboanga Sibugay
title.orig: An Act Creating Another Congressional District in the Province of Zamboanga Sibugay, amending for the purpose Republic Act Numbered Eighty-Nine Hundred and Seventy-Three, otherwise known as the Charter of the Province of Zamboanga Sibugay

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2006/ra_9360_2006.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section 7 of Republic Act No. 8973 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"SEC. 7. Congressional District. - The present Third District of the Province of Zamboanga del Sur shall constitute the Province of Zamboanga Sibugay which shall be divided into two (2) congressional districts as follows:
"District I - Buug, Diplahan, Malangas, Imelda, Alicia, Mabuhay, Olutanga, Talusan and Payao.
"District II - Siay, Kabasalan, Naga, Ipil, Titay, R.T. Lim and Tungawan.
"The Province of Zamboanga del Sur shall retain the two (2) legislative districts as follows:
"District I - Pagadian City, Labangan, Tukuran, Aurora, Molave, Mahayag, Dumingag, Suminot, Midsalip, Ramon Magsaysay, Tambulig, Josefina.
"District II - Bayog, Lakewood, Kumalarang, Tigbao, Dumalinao, Guipos, San Miguel, Lapuyan, Margosatubig, Dinas, San Pablo, Tabina, Dimataling, Vincenzo Sagun, Pitogo."
All laws, executive orders, regulations or parts thereof, inconsistent with the provisions of this Act, are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in at least two newspapers of general circulation in the Philippines.
